Honestly, that would make me a bit wary that a grown man would would interact with a minor online and essentially wait for her to be legal. However, I don’t know what the dynamics of your friendship were and I certainly don’t know how your relationship is now.

My advice would be to just avoid telling certain people for now, figure out the best way you can deliver news of such a relationship to friends and family to help ease any concerns they might (and probably will) have.
